messages:
ryan: Heads-up  Helios (SI) + Orion (HW partner) want a short tech walk-through: LangChain + LlamaIndex pipelines calling through Redwood Gateway into an Orion edge device. They need a reproducible sandbox customers can spin up.

anya: Recommend ephemeral OIDC client + 3min JWTs, rotate keys after each session. Also block publishing perf charts until Orion signs the benchmark NDA.

kevin: Infra options: Private sandbox VPC (fast) or Dedicated pool with strict ingress. For an externally runnable sandbox, Private with Vault-backed creds seems best.

mollie: Agree. We'll also pin model versions and include a fixed prompt bundle + RNG seed so demos are deterministic. Disable KV prefix caching for the demo.

ci-bot: note: created branch partnerships/helios-orion-demo and added smoke test 'helios-token-rotation' (status: queued)

ryan: Timeline: Helios asked for Thu 11am CET demo. Can we do internal dry run Wed 8am PT?

kevin: Wed 8am PT internal dry run works. I'll provision a Private sandbox by Wed 6am PT and push creds to Vault with a read-only demo role.

anya: I'll draft a 1-page runbook (onboarding steps, token flow, smoke tests, rollback) and include a short PKCE snippet. Please review when ready.

mollie: I'll prepare the prompt set and a tiny pytest that asserts logs appear in s3-demo and HMAC on webhooks verifies.

ryan: I'll send NDA to Orion + Helios and add marketing to the loop. Proposed embargo: 10 days after sign-off unless partners approve earlier.

ci-bot: pipeline: helios-token-rotation started (running)

kevin: Follow-ups: anya -> runbook PR by EOD Tue; kevin -> sandbox + Vault creds by Wed 6am PT; mollie -> smoke tests + prompt bundle.

mollie: ACK. Will include a minimal terraform routing snippet and a sample curl for the PKCE exchange.

anya: Thanks  ping me if blocked. :rocket:
